experiment_data.hypothesis: dt_embedding training (not its mere existence) is a necessary condition for CIVO collapse. Freezing dt_emb (random init, requires_grad=False) should prevent the reward-value divergence observed in exp_008d with trained dt_emb.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon && LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 python -u dreamer.py --configs defaults dmc_proprio --task dmc_walker_walk --steps 210000 --seed 0 --device cuda:0 --compile False --gate_enabled True --gate_fixed_dt 2 --gate_subsample_max_dt 2 --imag_horizon 8 --dt_emb_freeze True --logdir logdir/exp_042_frozen_dt_emb_walker"
